text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, as I was choosing lunch options with Fuji Kiseki at the cafeteria—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A slice of apple and... half an orange...
Yeah, this should be enough for today.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... I ate a bit too much for dinner last night,
so I thought I'd do this much today...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Truth is, recently my little ponies have been treating me
to lots of home-cooked meals every night."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I was just tasting a dish made by one student, but word spread before I knew it...
Now the dorm cafeteria looks like a full-blown buffet.
choice_data_list: Let's turn it down if it's too much.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, but still...
This dish is filled with everyone's feelings, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even so, being unable to control her food intake is a real issue...

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ah! Fuji-senpai! So this is where you were~!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you're the one who...
treated me to that delicious omelet rice last night...

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I made omurice again today!
Please, dig in-!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Getting to eat your omurice again
makes me the happiest girl in the whole academy♪

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek! Hearing you say that...
I'm so touched I could cryyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing this exchange prompted more and more students
to start cooking their own dishes."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hey... this one looks so happy.
It's okay to eat it, right?
choice_data_list: Let's keep it to just one bite.
Keep it to just one bite, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hey... this one looks so happy.
It's okay to eat it, right?
choice_data_list: Let's keep it to just one bite.
Keep it to just one bite, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Yeah, I got it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Pony-chan. You heard him, so...
would you mind if I had just a bite?

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Um... could it be that
you're on a diet... or something...?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, sorry.
I'll make sure to savor this bite♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Fuji Kiseki savored each bite,
chewing thoughtfully as she ate."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer-san.
For respecting my feelings.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well then, time to dig in... Wait, huh?
Isn't this even bigger than yesterday's omurice...?

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's packed full of my love!!
Please, dig in!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: No wonder your home cooking tastes so good♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Honoring her junior's heartfelt gesture,
Fuji Kiseki polished off the giant omurice...
